name: Endurance Tech.
why: Record quarterly sales, annual sales, annual profit
Working capital healthy - debtor days 45 to 46, inventory days 52 to 50 (not rising)
Management outlook: In Q3 FY 27, we expect steel prices to increase, and we see a softening of the aluminum alloy prices.
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Good (sales +34% YoY, profit +21% YoY)
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) raised holding by 1.4 pts in a year
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 180% of 3-year profit
risks: Margins shrinking (13% to 12%) - record profit may be near peak
Thin order book: only 0.4x annual sales
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 1.8 pts in a year
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 87% to 88% of sales)
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

order_book: Two things to highlight in the total business win order book of ₹ 6,372 crores as on H1 FY 27 compared to FY22 is as follows.
Jyoti: Another question around Bajaj that is excluded from the order book and I think largely we do around 30% - 35% of revenue from Bajaj.
guidance: In Q3 FY 27, we expect steel prices to increase, and we see a softening of the aluminum alloy prices.
We expect cumulative SOP for 4W suspension, brakes and drive shaft to increase from ₹ 100 crores in FY 28 to ₹ 800 crores in FY 31.
capex: Fondalpress offers a strong location, a track record of generating over € 60 million in highly profitable revenue, best-in -class quality, factory management processes, and a significant scope for expansion.
By Q4 FY 27, for ABS, we will have a capacity of 1.54 million single and dual channel ABSs per annum, of which 70% is already booked by Bajaj Auto and Royal Enfield.
risks: At the same time, geopolitical tensions, particularly in West Asia, have increased the volatility in energy prices and added to uncertainty around global trade and supply chains.
focus: Our newly established battery pack business has made good progress, marking another important milestone in our diversification into emerging mobility technologies, a journey that began with our acquisition of Maxwell.
Our strong R&D and innovation cell at Maxwell at Bangalore is also focusing on the IoT and V 2X solutions, TPMS, and high-voltage Battery Management Systems for 4W and e -buses.
This shows our company’s increasing focus on electric vehicle and four -wheeler new order wins.
